instruction: Does the reviewer recommend the product?

would recommend.definition: The reviewer expresses clear satisfaction with the product and indicates, either explicitly or through strong positive sentiment, that others should purchase or use it; borderline cases where the reviewer mentions minor drawbacks but still concludes positively are included.
examples: This blender works amazingly well and is worth every penny—I'd definitely buy it again!
Despite being a bit noisy, this vacuum cleans perfectly and I have no problem recommending it to anyone.

would not recommend.definition: The reviewer expresses dissatisfaction with the product and indicates, either explicitly or through strong negative sentiment, that others should avoid it; borderline cases where the reviewer notes some positives but ultimately deems the product not worth it are included.
examples: The headphones broke after two days and the sound quality was poor—save your money and avoid this brand.
It looked nice at first, but the fabric fell apart after one wash; I can't recommend something so poorly made.
